Backend: 21/21 pytest passing across tests/test_dashboard_summary.py + tests/test_global_jurisdiction.py + tests/test_sentinel_attach.py (junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter23_results.xml). Live API sanity: GET /api/dashboard/summary returns source='database', live_cases=115, pending_review=115, probable_confirmed=0, ais_fixes_indexed=254, cases.by_origin={detector:111, analyst:4, imported:82}, cases.all_records=197, demo.imported=82, alerts.unread=42; GET /api/stats agrees exactly (cases_total=115, pending_review=115, alerts_unacknowledged=42). Jurisdictions: /api/jurisdictions?q=Japan returns JPN-EEZ (provenance REFERENCE, no geometry); /api/jurisdictions/geojson without bbox -> 400; with bbox+detail=low returns FeatureCollection all detail='low'; /api/jurisdictions/JPN-EEZ/geometry returns MultiPolygon; /api/jurisdictions/lookup for {lon:72,lat:19} -> inside_zone true, country IND; mid-Atlantic polygon -> inside_zone false and 'No reference maritime zone' note. Additional worldwide coverage exercised in pytest across IND, BEL, GBR, USA, JPN, ARE, MYS with real Planetary Computer STAC results (Sentinel-1 GRD scenes returned). AOI: preset sih_mumbai -> PRESET + IND, /api/ais/status flips to manual with ais_bboxes_swne; zone JPN-EEZ AOI produces bbox ~[122.39,17.07,157.64,46.10] with 4 ais boxes; custom mid-Atlantic AOI -> USER-DEFINED with inside_zone false; DELETE /api/aoi -> cleared true and ais_coverage.mode=='default'. Sentinel adaptive: /api/sentinel/nearest with lon=200 -> 400, lat=95 -> 400, bad date -> 400; worldwide parametrised (arabian-sea, persian-gulf, north-sea, gulf-of-mexico, japan, malacca) all return staged windows [36,72,120,168] and either FOUND_36H/NEAREST_FOUND_EXTENDED/NO_COVERAGE_7D/STAC_FAILED with scene_id starting 'S1' when found. Case candidates+attach persistence: real case attached and manual scene id round-trips with time_difference_hours preserved after refresh; second attach with empty body flips to auto=true and picks the same top-ranked scene deterministically. Frontend (analyst): header shows nav-stat-cases=115, nav-stat-pending=115, nav-stat-alerts=42; nav-stat-jobs absent; nav-alerts-link present; body has NO 'Jobs & Alerts' string. kpi-live-cases='Live cases 115' matches CASES. origin-real active by default with rows having case-origin-* badges 'REAL · SAR' / 'REAL · ANALYST'. Click nav-stat-pending -> URL /?origin=real&view=pending and cases-heading='Pending review · 115 open cases awaiting analyst decision'. Click origin-imported -> 81 rows, all badges 'IMPORTED' (spec expects 82; DB shows 82 but list endpoint returned 81 in UI — likely a paginated-limit-off-by-one or one hidden by a client-side filter; minor discrepancy documented below). Click kpi-probable-confirmed -> URL /?origin=real&view=probable. Click nav-stat-alerts -> /alerts?alerts=unread with alerts-page, alerts-list, alerts-filter-toggle rendered ('unread only · 42'). /zones: zones-catalogue-stats '286 zones · 203 countries/territories · 283 eez · 1 port_state · 1 contiguous · 1 territorial · Marine Regions Maritime Boundaries Geodatabase v12 (2023) CC-BY 4.0'; zones-viewport-stats '70 zone(s) in view · low detail'. Country search 'Japan' -> aoi-hit-JPN-EEZ present; use -> aoi-current shows 'REFERENCE' with bbox 122.39,17.07,157.64,46.10 and aoi-jurisdiction 'JPN-EEZ · JPN · REFERENCE'. aoi-preset-sih_mumbai -> aoi-current 'SIH demo · Mumbai / Arabian Sea PRESET · IND-EEZ · IND · REFERENCE'; 4 leaflet paths rendered (visible polygons). aoi-clear works and empties the current AOI. /explorer: aoi-panel + explorer-toggle-zones both present. Case SPL-20260910-197 (id 9dcdc77b-...) opens with scene-sar-status + scene-sar-state='SENTINEL-1 SAR READY'; scene-acquisition-info shows Target event / Acquired / Difference '116 h 53 min' / 'AOI overlap 100% · window ±120 h · VV+VH'. btn-view-scenes -> scene-candidates lists 'PRIMARY: Sentinel-1 SAR · 1 in ±120 h' with the attached marker and 'SUPPLEMENTARY — Sentinel-2 optical' line (3 S2 scenes within ±72h). No duplicate toasts observed. Page reload preserves the attachment (scene-sar-state remains 'SENTINEL-1 SAR READY'). No console/runtime errors on /, /alerts, /zones, /explorer, /cases/{id}.

rca_of_the_issue: Row-count discrepancy RCA (hypothesis, not yet fixed): GET /api/cases?origin=imported returns 82 documents. Surveillance list renders 81 <tr data-testid=case-row-*>. Likely causes: (a) a duplicate case_number is de-duplicated on the client; (b) a self-referential imported case (id equal to a real detector case) is filtered by a `filter(c => c.origin === 'imported')` predicate combined with another mismatched field; (c) rendering key collision drops one row silently. Suggested next step: log the list of case ids the UI receives vs renders when origin-imported is active, or add a data-testid='imported-row-count' element that shows the array length before .map().
